story.title: The Borrowed Shadow
story.logline: A lonely teenager trades his shadow for a companion, only to realize the shadow was carrying something vital.
story.twist: The shadow wasn't absorbing light; it was absorbing all the physical pain the boy was supposed to feel.
story.ending: Now the pain is flooding back, and the shadow is walking away forever.

scenes.narration: My shadow walked away from me last Tuesday, leaving my feet completely naked on the cold concrete sidewalk.
scenes.visual_prompt: 17-year-old boy, messy dark hair, oversized black hoodie, standing on a gloomy urban sidewalk under a streetlamp with no shadow cast behind him. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narration: I did not scream. I just smiled because for the first time in my life, I wasn't alone.
scenes.visual_prompt: 17-year-old boy, messy dark hair, oversized black hoodie, smiling broadly on the gloomy urban sidewalk, looking down at his feet. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narration: It stood by my locker, nodding at my jokes and filling the empty space where my friends should be.
scenes.visual_prompt: 17-year-old boy, messy dark hair, oversized black hoodie, standing in a dim high school hallway next to a distinct, moving dark silhouette that mimics talking. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narration: People finally noticed me. They whispered in the corridors, staring at the double silhouette walking beside my frame.
scenes.visual_prompt: 17-year-old boy, messy dark hair, oversized black hoodie, walking down a school hallway while classmates stare in shock. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narration: Then came the soccer match. I tripped hard over the turf, expecting the usual agonizing crack in my ankle.
scenes.visual_prompt: 17-year-old boy, messy dark hair, oversized black hoodie, falling on a green soccer field under stadium lights, grimacing in anticipation. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narration: Instead, I felt nothing. Absolutely nothing. My shadow writhed on the grass, absorbing a violent snap that belonged to me.
scenes.visual_prompt: 17-year-old boy, messy dark hair, oversized black hoodie, sitting untouched on the green soccer field while his distinct shadow twists unnaturally on the turf. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narration: That was the bargain. It took my shape so it could take my suffering, keeping my fragile body completely safe.
scenes.visual_prompt: 17-year-old boy, messy dark hair, oversized black hoodie, touching his undamaged ankle on the dark turf, looking terrified at the ground. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narration: Tonight, the shadow stopped mimicking me. It stood up straight, shook its head, and turned toward the open road.
scenes.visual_prompt: 17-year-old boy, messy dark hair, oversized black hoodie, watching a separate dark figure detach completely from the pavement and walk away under a streetlamp. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narration: As it crossed the street into the dark, every broken bone it ever saved for me instantly returned.
scenes.visual_prompt: 17-year-old boy, messy dark hair, oversized black hoodie, clutching his legs on the sidewalk in sudden, overwhelming agony under the streetlamp. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narration: Now my shadow is gone, and I am finally feeling everything it carried for me.
scenes.visual_prompt: 17-year-old boy, messy dark hair, oversized black hoodie, lying alone on the dark sidewalk with no shadow anywhere in sight. Vertical 9:16.

caption.hook: I traded my shadow for a friend.
caption.title: The Borrowed Shadow
caption.caption:
Loneliness made me desperate enough to trade away the silhouette trailing my feet just to feel less alone. But I only realized too late what it was actually carrying for me.

What are you willing to sacrifice for comfort?
